raw_text:
ChezMoi dotfiles repo. Source: `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`; target: `~/`. Apply copies, not symlinks. NEVER edit managed files in `~/`; edit source or use `chezmoi edit`.

chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc

Prefixes: `dot_` → dotfile; `private_` → `600`/`700`; `executable_` → executable; `symlink_` → symlink; `.tmpl` → template; `run_before_`, `run_after_`, `run_once_` → script timing. Files with `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. Define variables in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`.

Store scripts in `~/.local/bin/`:
code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
Source path: `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`. Ensure PATH includes:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.

Bash template: `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`; use `set -euo pipefail`. Naming: `fct_*` functions, `log_*` logging, `UPPER_CASE` constants/env vars, `lower_case` locals. Use `log_info`, `log_error`; exit via `exit "${exit_code}"`.

Run scripts: `.chezmoiscripts/` (v2.9+). `.chezmoiignore` excludes `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*`, `.DS_Store`. See `crash_procedure.md`; docs: https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/

Before solving from scratch, search cass for prior solutions. NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5
cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json
cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json
cass capabilities --json
cass robot-docs guide
Use `--fields minimal` for essential fields; `--limit N`, `--agent NAME`, `--days N` filter results. stdout=data; stderr=diagnostics; exit 0=success.
